properties.notes: In November 2019, the Council's East Area Planning Committee resolved to grant planning permission (19/01038/FUL), subject to the signing of a legal agreement, for the demolition of existing buildings and the phased construction of key worker housing comprising 56 cluster units, 21 x 1 bed studio apartments, 48 flats (17x1 bed, 31 x 2 beds), management office and associated works including parking and landscaping (additional/revised information). The site is allocated in the Sites and Housing Plan adopted in February 2013. Key worker housing linked to the hospital is identified as a suitable use. General housing and student accommodation are identified as acceptable complementary uses. Hospital operations would need to be maintained. The site is also allocated in the emerging Local Plan 2036, which is currently undergoing an examination in public (consultation on proposed modifications following hearings).
